notes.title: Ver1.1.0
notes.content:
Revised stage design
Adjusted evasion action behavior
Changed evasion activation to occur upon pressing the evasion button
Removed dash and increased normal movement speed
Fixed a bug where the player became unresponsive when picking up items
Balanced enemy stats
Changed Japanese font
Adjusted crosshair size
Made camera sensitivity adjustment more detailed
Fixed an issue with simultaneous pressing of the Assassin Rope and Jump buttons
Fixed a bug where arrows were blocked by invisible walls
Changed Earth Axe weapon skill to a guard buff
Reduced the arrow speed of bow-wielding enemies
Fixed a bug where rings couldn't be equipped during mouse operation
Adjusted camera lock-on behavior
Decreased the power of weapons
Decreased the power of the Attack Up Ring
Reduced damage from poison swamps

notes.title: Bug fixes
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug that prevented progression of Stage 5 treasure chests.
- Fixed the hit reaction of the barb iron ball.
- Stage 4 level design adjustment
